# pvs (pvs.origincloudapis.eu)

Guide: <https://docs.origincloud.eu/docs/storage/index.html.md>
Commands: `origin pvs <command>`. Add `--output json` to every command whose output you read.

- **SnapshotService**: Snapshots: point-in-time copies of a volume, in the volume's zone.
- **StorageClassService**: The catalog of storage classes: every tier the platform publishes, each saying whether it can be selected right now.
- **VolumeService**: Block storage volumes: durable disks in one zone that an instance attaches to read and write.

## Ask before

These delete something or can't be undone: show the user what will change and wait for their yes.

- `origin pvs delete-snapshot`: deletes for good.
- `origin pvs update-volume`, changing `--size-gib`: A volume never shrinks back, and its larger size is charged.
- `origin pvs delete-volume`: deletes for good.

## Commands

### `origin pvs get-snapshot`

Returns a snapshot.

```sh
origin pvs get-snapshot --snapshot <SNAPSHOT>
```

Also: `--project <PROJECT>`, `--zone <ZONE>`

### `origin pvs list-snapshots`

Lists the snapshots in a zone, oldest first.

```sh
origin pvs list-snapshots
```

Also: `--project <PROJECT>`, `--zone <ZONE>`, `--page-size <PAGE_SIZE>`, `--page-token <PAGE_TOKEN>`

### `origin pvs create-snapshot`

Takes a snapshot of a volume.

```sh
origin pvs create-snapshot --source-volume <VOLUME>
```

Also: `--project <PROJECT>`, `--zone <ZONE>`, `--tag <KEY=VALUE> ...`, `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>`, `--no-wait`

- starts an operation and waits for it, unless `--no-wait`; its result is a `Snapshot`
- `--request-id` makes a retry safe

### `origin pvs update-snapshot`

Changes a snapshot's tags.

```sh
origin pvs update-snapshot --snapshot <SNAPSHOT>
```

Also: `--project <PROJECT>`, `--zone <ZONE>`, `--tag <KEY=VALUE> ...`, `--no-tags`

### `origin pvs delete-snapshot`

Deletes a snapshot.

```sh
origin pvs delete-snapshot --snapshot <SNAPSHOT>
```

Also: `--project <PROJECT>`, `--zone <ZONE>`, `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>`, `--no-wait`, `--yes`

- **ask first**: deletes for good
- starts an operation and waits for it, unless `--no-wait`; its result is a `Empty`
- `--request-id` makes a retry safe
- refuses without `--yes`; pass it only after the user agreed

### `origin pvs protect-snapshot`

Protects a snapshot, so it can be the source of volumes and images and can't be deleted.

```sh
origin pvs protect-snapshot --snapshot <SNAPSHOT>
```

Also: `--project <PROJECT>`, `--zone <ZONE>`, `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>`, `--no-wait`

- starts an operation and waits for it, unless `--no-wait`; its result is a `Snapshot`
- `--request-id` makes a retry safe

### `origin pvs unprotect-snapshot`

Unprotects a snapshot, so it can be deleted.

```sh
origin pvs unprotect-snapshot --snapshot <SNAPSHOT>
```

Also: `--project <PROJECT>`, `--zone <ZONE>`, `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>`, `--no-wait`

- starts an operation and waits for it, unless `--no-wait`; its result is a `Snapshot`
- `--request-id` makes a retry safe

### `origin pvs get-storage-class`

Returns a storage class.

```sh

```


### `origin pvs list-storage-classes`

Lists every storage class, including those not yet on sale: check `available` before selecting one.

```sh

```

### `origin pvs create-volume`

```sh

```

Also: `--project <PROJECT>`, `--zone <ZONE>`, `--storage-class <STORAGE_CLASS>`, `--source-snapshot <SNAPSHOT>`, `--tag <KEY=VALUE> ...`, `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>`, `--no-wait`

- starts an operation and waits for it, unless `--no-wait`; its result is a `Volume`
- `--request-id` makes a retry safe

### `origin pvs import-volume`

Creates a volume whose initial content is a disk image the platform downloads.

```sh

```

Also: `--project <PROJECT>`, `--zone <ZONE>`, `--storage-class <STORAGE_CLASS>`, `--tag <KEY=VALUE> ...`, `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>`, `--no-wait`

- `--request-id` makes a retry safe

### `origin pvs update-volume`

Changes a volume's size or tags.

```sh

```

Also: `--project <PROJECT>`, `--zone <ZONE>`, `--size-gib <SIZE_GIB>`, `--tag <KEY=VALUE> ...`, `--no-tags`, `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>`, `--no-wait`, `--yes`

- **ask first** when changing `volume.size_gib`: A volume never shrinks back, and its larger size is charged.
- starts an operation and waits for it, unless `--no-wait`; its result is a `Volume`
- `--request-id` makes a retry safe
- refuses without `--yes`; pass it only after the user agreed

- **ask first**: deletes for good

### Operations

`origin pvs get-operation` reads an operation, `origin pvs wait-operation` waits for it: give the operation's `name` exactly as the command printed it.

## Resources

### Snapshot

A point-in-time copy of a volume.

- Full name: `//pvs.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/snapshots/{snapshot}`
- `name`: `projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/snapshots/{snapshot}`

| Field (JSON) | Type | Behavior | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | identifier | The snapshot's resource name. |
| `urn` | string | output only | The snapshot's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use. |
| `sourceVolume` | string | required, immutable | The volume copied, in the same project and zone. Names a `Volume`. |
| `sourceSizeGib` | int32 | output only | The source volume's size in GiB when it was copied: the least a volume created from the snapshot holds. |
| `state` | Snapshot.State | output only | Where the copy is. One of `PENDING`, `COMPLETED`, `DELETING`, `DELETED`, `ERROR`. |
| `stateReason` | string | output only | Why the snapshot is in `ERROR`; empty otherwise. |
| `protectionState` | Snapshot.ProtectionState | output only | Whether it is protected. One of `UNPROTECTED`, `PROTECTING`, `PROTECTED`, `UNPROTECTING`, `PROTECTION_FAILED`. |
| `protectionReason` | string | output only | Why the last protection change failed, when `protection_state` is `PROTECTION_FAILED`. |
| `creator` | string | output only | The principal that took the snapshot, such as `user:<id>` or `service_account:<id>`. |
| `tags` | map<string, string> | optional | Labels of your own, at most 50. |

### StorageClass

A storage tier a volume is created in.

- Full name: `//pvs.origincloudapis.eu/storageClasses/{storage_class}`
- `name`: `storageClasses/{storage_class}`

| Field (JSON) | Type | Behavior | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | identifier | The class's resource name, `storageClasses/gp1`. |
| `displayName` | string | output only | The name the console shows. |
| `media` | StorageClass.Media | output only | The media the class is backed by. One of `SSD`, `HDD`. |
| `defaultClass` | bool | output only | Whether a volume created without a storage class is created in this one. |
| `available` | bool | output only | Whether the class can be selected right now. |
| `baselineIops` | int32 | output only | The I/O operations per second a volume of the class is limited to; 0 for a class not on sale. |
| `baselineThroughputMibps` | int32 | output only | The MiB per second a volume of the class is limited to; 0 for a class not on sale. |

### Volume

A block storage volume in one zone.

- Full name: `//pvs.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/volumes/{volume}`
- `name`: `projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/volumes/{volume}`

| Field (JSON) | Type | Behavior | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | identifier | The volume's resource name. |
| `urn` | string | output only | The volume's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use. |
| `sizeGib` | int32 | required | The size in GiB, at least 1. |
| `storageClass` | string | optional, immutable | The storage class, `storageClasses/{storage_class}`. Names a `StorageClass`. |
| `sourceSnapshot` | string | optional, immutable | The snapshot the volume was created from, in the same project and zone; empty for an empty volume. Names a `Snapshot`. |
| `state` | Volume.State | output only | Where the volume is in its lifecycle. One of `CREATING`, `AVAILABLE`, `IN_USE`, `DELETING`, `DELETED`, `ERROR`. |
| `stateReason` | string | output only | Why the volume is in `ERROR`; empty otherwise. |
| `attachment` | string | output only | When `state` is `IN_USE`, the id of the volume attachment holding it. |
| `resizeState` | Volume.ResizeState | output only | Where the last resize is. One of `RESIZE_COMPLETED`, `RESIZING`, `RESIZE_FAILED`. |
| `resizeReason` | string | output only | Why the last resize failed, when `resize_state` is `RESIZE_FAILED`. |
| `pendingSizeGib` | int32 | output only | The size a resize under way is heading for; 0 when none is. |
| `retentionNote` | string | output only | Why the volume is still here after the instance it was created with was terminated; empty in every other case. |
| `iops` | int32 | output only | The most I/O operations per second the volume serves, reads and writes combined: a ceiling, not a guaranteed rate. |
| `throughputMibps` | int32 | output only | The most MiB per second the volume transfers, reads and writes combined: a ceiling, not a guaranteed rate. |
| `creator` | string | output only | The principal that created the volume, such as `user:<id>` or `service_account:<id>`. |
| `tags` | map<string, string> | optional | Labels of your own, at most 50. |
